title: Delivery Evidence Schema
description: Validates one <delivery root>/<tranche>/evidence.yaml: the record a tranche leaves of who wrote each stage and of its reviews. Local shape only: stage completeness, allowed models and fallbacks, reviewer independence, finding outcomes and SHA resolution are cross-field validator concerns (src/delivery.ts).
$comment: Shipped by the delivery profile (delivery_evidence). `reviews` is chronological: a repair loop appends a new entry for the same stage rather than editing the earlier one.

tranche.description: Must equal the tranche folder name.

status.description: open: the lifecycle is in progress. ready: every configured stage is approved and approved_sha is the commit to merge.

base_sha.$comment: Informational: the commit the tranche started from. Not checked; the gate derives its range from Git.

pr.$comment: Informational: the pull request URL. Not checked.

work.description: Who wrote each stage, in order: one entry per stage written, more after a repair.

run.description: Identifies the process: a session id, a pane id plus start time, or the report file. Two entries with the same run are the same process.

fallback.description: Why a later model in the stage's list was used: counted failures of the preferred one, or the operator's order (kind operator), which references its ruling instead and is accepted only for a model the stage lists.

role.description: Which actor fell back; author is the 0.9 spelling of writer. Default: writer on a work entry, reviewer on a review.

kind.description: Why the model counts as unavailable, or operator when the operator ordered the substitution. A verdict is never one of these.

failures.description: Failures observed before falling back; at least delivery.fallback.after_failures.

window.description: When the first and last counted failures happened; the span is at most delivery.fallback.within_minutes.

decided_by.description: operator only: who ruled, by name or board identity. Never the driver on its own authority.

decided_at.description: operator only: when the ruling was given.

ruling.description: operator only: where the ruling is recorded (a board message id, an ADR or a PR).

reason.description: Why the preferred model was not used: an outage, a rate limit, no auditable report, or the operator's order. Never a verdict.

id.description: Stable across re-reviews, so an upheld finding keeps its id.

evidence.description: Concrete: file:line, a failing command, a counter-example.

proposed_fix.description: A precise correction for the author to apply; the reviewer never applies it.

rebuttal.description: The author's written dispute, with evidence. One round only.

decision.description: The human's ruling when outcome is human.

sha.description: The commit the stage's work ended at.

stage.description: The stage reviewed. The 0.9 names read as plan, red, refactor and final.

author.$comment: 0.9: the writer of the reviewed work. Records now name writers under work.

checked.description: Everything the reviewer went through, not only what failed.

report.description: Path of the retained raw reviewer output, inside the tranche's folder.
